title: Kestrel and the Salt
author: Astrid Delacroix
blurb: Wendell Brightwater, the keeper of a gate that should stay shut, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. Then the border wards fall on the same night the stars go out — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must find the door out of a country that no longer exists, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
